collection.title: Suzuki X-90 1995 to 1998 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a  Suzuki X-90 1995 - 1998 model which requires a 20" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
